QuestInfo.name: Return to Ereve
QuestInfo.0: Return to Ereve and report what you went through at #b#m230040400##k.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart says he will look into the Black Wing forces you encountered at the Deep Sea. He asks you to report to the Empress.
QuestInfo.2: You tried to report to the Empress, but she was asleep! Maybe you should just quietly leave the report next her?

0.0: I trust you can give me a full report on what the Black Wings are up to?
0.1: I see. Whisked away the moment you touched one of them... Interesting. I believe you, of course. One hundred percent.
0.2: If Hawkeye is investigating the area, I trust he'll do a thorough job. In the meantime, deliver my report to the Empress.

yes.0: Here is the report. Try not to spill coffee on it.

no.0: Oh? Did you have something more important to do? More important than saving the entire world from the clutches of the Black Mage?

1.0: ... \r\n#L0##b(The Empress appears to be sleeping.) Empress? Empress... Empress!!#l\n#k

npc.0: What is it about this simple task that do you not understand? Take this report to Cygnus. You do know who Cygnus is, don't you?

lost.0: You forgot the report... Take it to Cygnus at once.
